notes: «علي يعني ابن الجعد» — the inline gloss «يعني ابن الجعد» is left out, so the surface is «علي».
«حدثني صاحب هذه الدار» is an unnamed Companion (rule 8); the text points to a house but does not name him, and that is not a name to take.
The questioner in «سألت رسول الله» is this unnamed man, so he is the last link (the one who speaks).
